name: Cart abandonment — email & in-app
description: Waits up to 1 hour after cart_abandoned. If cart_completed arrives for the same cart_id, exits without sending. Otherwise sends email and in-app (inbox) via one multi-channel step.

nodes.name: Wait for checkout or 1 hour
nodes.description: Exit early when cart_completed matches cart_id; otherwise wait 1 hour then send reminder.

branches.name: Purchase completed
branches.description: User checked out — skip abandonment reminder.

nodes.name: End — no reminder
nodes.description: No notification; workflow completes after purchase.

branches.name: Max wait — send reminder
branches.description: No matching cart_completed within 1 hour — send abandonment reminder.

nodes.name: Send email and in-app reminder
nodes.description: Requires a template that supports email + inbox channels.
